policy: Development-only advisories with no published fix may be accepted for a short, dated period after review. Production advisories are never accepted here. `npm run audit:security` remains the strict release gate and still fails while any exception exists.

history.resolution: Removed from the dependency tree: @next/eslint-plugin-next's only fast-glob call now resolves to the reviewed in-repo package tooling/fast-glob-shim (Node fs.globSync), so fast-glob, micromatch and braces are no longer installed. See docs/security/dependency-audit-2026-10-21.md.
